title: 第1章 失忆第2章 划清界限
slug: 恶毒师妹失忆后师兄们悔疯了
content_zh:
痛。
浑身都是抽筋剥皮之痛，喉间堵着一团血气，连呼吸都带着铁锈的腥甜。
苏虞想醒来，身体却软绵无力，像是被什么东西紧紧束缚。
身体的本能叫她，不必醒。
意识沉浮中，几张模糊的脸像恶鬼般缠上来。
“师妹，你如今年岁已有十五，为何还这样刁蛮任性？你忘了师父对你的教导了吗？”
温润的声音此刻字字透着失望。
“贪功冒进，不听人言，不仅害得大家都掉进陷阱，师姐还为了救你差点失去一条手臂！苏虞，你的心怎会如此狠毒？！”
一双狐狸眼平日里看人总带着三分笑，此刻却满是厌恶和冷意。
“都什么时候了你还在针对大师姐！现在她灵根尽毁，你满意了吧！”
最后这个声音最年轻，恨意也最直白，语气尖锐得像刀子，扎得人血肉模糊。
对此，苏虞只有一个想法。
你们谁啊上来就骂我？！
有本事来打一架啊！
……
苏虞是被气醒的。
不仅浑身都疼，脑子里还有几个人叨叨叨叨，烦死个人。
就算是她爹都没这么骂过她！
然而映入眼帘的陌生环境让她愣住了。
物件昂贵，香气混着药味蔓延，到处都透着一股刻意营造出来的雅致。

怎么看都不像她那老破小的家。
苏虞咬牙走到门口，看到翠绿茂盛的树木和云雾缭绕的远山后，皱起眉头。
她家棚呢？
她养的狗，种的菜呢？
还有她爹呢？
就在苏虞懵逼之际，一个身着白衣的男子御剑而来，轻盈落地，风度翩翩。
只是他一开口就让苏虞心生厌恶。
“小师妹。”
叶怀渊看着门口面色苍白、只着单薄寝衣的少女，眼中掠过一丝复杂的情绪，但很快便被惯有的责备取代。
“灵根一事我也深感遗憾，但此番你确实闯下了弥天大祸。”
“或许这样，对你，对大家都好。”
“放心，过些日子将会有秘境开放，我自会为你寻些草药来疗伤……只是今后，你莫要再如此任性了。”
content_en:
pain.
His whole body was filled with the pain of cramping and peeling, his throat was clogged with blood, and even his breath had the sweet taste of rust.
Su Yu wanted to wake up, but her body was limp, as if tightly bound by something.
Her body's instinct told her not to wake up.
As his consciousness drifted, several blurry faces haunted him like evil spirits.
"Junior sister, you are now fifteen years old, why are you still so unruly and willful? Have you forgotten what master taught you?"
The gentle voice was full of disappointment at this moment.
"Being greedy for success and not listening to others not only caused everyone to fall into the trap, but Senior Sister almost lost an arm trying to save you! Su Yu, how could your heart be so vicious?!"
A pair of fox eyes usually looked at people with a smile, but now they were full of disgust and coldness.
"How long has it been and you are still targeting Senior Sister! Now her spiritual roots are completely destroyed, are you satisfied?"
The last voice was the youngest, with the most direct hatred, and the tone was as sharp as a knife, cutting people's flesh and blood.
Su Yu only had one idea about this.
Which of you comes up and scolds me? !
Come and have a fight if you can!
…
Su Yu was awakened by anger.
Not only does my whole body hurt, but there are also several people nagging in my head, which is annoying me to death.
Even her father never scolded her like that!
However, the unfamiliar environment that greeted her eyes stunned her.
The objects are expensive, the aroma is mixed with the smell of medicine, and there is a deliberate elegance everywhere.
It doesn't look like her old and small home.
Su Yu gritted his teeth and walked to the door. After seeing the lush green trees and the distant mountains shrouded in mist, he frowned.
Where is her shed?
Where are the dogs she raises and the vegetables she grows?
And what about her father?
Just when Su Yu was confused, a man in white came with a sword, landed lightly and gracefully.
But Su Yu felt disgusted as soon as he opened his mouth.
"Little junior sister."
Ye Huaiyuan looked at the pale girl wearing only thin pajamas at the door. A trace of complicated emotions flashed in his eyes, but it was quickly replaced by the usual blame.
"I also deeply regret the spiritual root matter, but you did cause a huge disaster this time."
"Perhaps this will be good for you and everyone."
"Don't worry, a secret realm will be opened in a few days, and I will find some herbs for you to heal your injuries... But from now on, don't be so willful again."
